'''Gravity Control Centers''' were structures on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] in the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. Six of them were used to regulate the [[City/Legends|city's]] [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]], and if disabled, the city could be destroyed. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the city was [[Occupation of Bespin|attacked]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to take control of the city after [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] betrayed [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] defenders attempted to destroy the Gravity Control Generators to prevent the city's takeover.

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}
The Imperial strike force took control of over half of the Gravity Control Generators to prevent their destruction, and ultimately took control of all of Cloud City.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Gravity Control Generators appear in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' during the Darth Vader campaign. The player must secure half of the Gravity Control Generators to win the mission. The campaign was later included in the game's [[2002]] expansion pack, [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']].
